evidence.quote: Shoreditch's club for the whole you

findings.value: The site says the Sanctuary is wheelchair accessible and asks visitors with specific access needs to message on WhatsApp before a visit. Step-free access to each room is not stated.

evidence.quote: The Sanctuary is wheelchair accessible. If you have specific access requirements, message us on WhatsApp before your visit

findings.value: Single class £28; Unlimited Sanctuary membership £149 a month; first three classes £49 for new visitors, valid for 14 days.

evidence.quote: A single class is £28, and first-time visitors can book three classes for £49, valid for 14 days.
Unlimited Sanctuary membership is £149 a month

notes: Access answer is the FAQ on /get-in-touch (no separate access page), so access_page is left empty. The FAQ says 'wheelchair accessible' for 'The Sanctuary' without saying the sauna or studios are step-free, so step_free is left null for the editor. Whole-venue capacity is not stated; the 40-person Aufguss sauna in The Sensorium is one room only. Opening hours differ between sources (home page 'Mo-Fr 07:00-22:00', 'Sa-Su 08:45-22:00'; FAQ 'Saturday and Sunday 09:00 to 22:00'), so none are proposed. No age policy found on the pages read.
